firm_data.firm_description: Karabatos Rosenkrantz DeMarco Schoenfeld (KRDS) is a New York family law firm specializing in complex financial, valuation, and property distribution matters, as well as difficult custody and support issues. The firm's attorneys have a long-standing record of success handling matrimonial and family law cases.
notable_facts: The firm is the successor to Schlissel Ostrow Karabatos, PLLC.
The founding partners have practiced law together for over 25 years.
The firm has attorneys who are fellows of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and Diplomates of the American College of Family Trial Lawyers.
The firm is recognized by Best Lawyers in America©, Martindale-Hubbell, and Super Lawyers.

email.subject: AI for KRDS, built for complex matrimonial work
email.body:
Hi Elena,

KRDS handles the kind of complex financial, valuation, and property distribution matters that demand precision and deep expertise. That's exactly why we built Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Garden City area to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
